entries.label: fur_fine_a: fine soft fur, subtlest
entries.notes: Fine strands about 2 texels wide at 4096, flowing down and back from the face. Normal tilt mean 4 deg. Original colors kept; strand shading in albedo +/-2.5%, slight roughness and occlusion variation. Replaces the rejected chunky-lock pass.

entries.label: fur_fine_b: fine soft fur, medium
entries.notes: Same fine strands plus a soft second octave so mid range reads as a directional sheen. Normal tilt mean 6 deg. Albedo strand shading +/-4%.

entries.label: fur_fine_c: fine soft fur, strongest
entries.notes: Same as b, stronger. Normal tilt mean 9 deg. Albedo strand shading +/-5.5%. Still fine strands, no clumps.
